exposure: Presence of specific bacterial and fungal taxa on skin swab samples collected in the first week of life
cohort: 72 children in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at a single site hospital
finding: The development of atopic dermatitis (AD) was associated with differences in the abundance of several bacterial and fungal taxa and metabolic pathways present on the skin shortly after birth, suggesting that this dysbiosis may precede disease onset.
